author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:1900237 positive regulation of induction of conjugation with cellular fusion -> GO:0031139 positive regulation of conjugation with cellular fusion
GO:0090029 negative regulation of pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion -> GO:0180040 negative regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0090028 positive regulation of pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion -> GO:0062038 positive regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0000750 pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion -> GO:0071507    pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0010514 induction of conjugation with cellular fusion ->  GO:0031139 positive regulation of conjugation with cellular fusion
GO:0010515 negative regulation of induction of conjugation with cellular fusion -> GO:0031138 negative regulation of conjugation with cellular fusion
GO:0010969 regulation of pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion -> GO:0180039 regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0032005 signal transduction involved in positive regulation of conjugation with cellular fusion -> GO:0071507 pheromone response MAPK cascade

(Annotations should be made in GOCAM; move to parent terms for now.)

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31335

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1e_1LfS5iAHlC9CPSks00F8dnbBFIKBzrlZJk3Ap7qhA/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
CGD	14
ComplexPortal	12
SGD	48
~UniProt	1~
~PomBase	68~

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
term	file	line
GO:0000750	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR016326 Mating factor alpha > GO:pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion ; GO:0000750
GO:0000750	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR035296 Mating hormone A-factor 1/2 > GO:pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion ; GO:0000750
GO:0000750	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR041848 Guanine nucleotide-binding protein subunit gamma, fungal > GO:pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion ; GO:0000750
GO:0000750	unirule2go	UniRule:UR000142757 > GO:pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion ; GO:0000750



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to regulation of conjugation with cellular fusion and subclasses

author: ValWood
body:
hi @raymond91125 

These 3 terms:
GO:0180040 negative regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0062038 positive regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade
GO:0180039 regulation of pheromone response MAPK cascade

shouldn't be in the obsoletion list. These are the terms that many of the existing annotations will migrate to (all those immediately upstream of the pheromone response MAPK cascade back to the pheromone receptor.

v

author: sarach06
body:
Hi,
Thank you very much for this. I have checked the InterPro entries and removed/replaced the term to be obsolete, accordingly. These changes will be visible in the next InterPro release (109.0).

Best regards,
Sara
